description: Parking meters located on the territory of the City of Brussels is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Horodateurs situés sur le territoire de la Ville de Bruxelles Un horodateur est un automate qui permet de payer un droit de stationnement. Il enregistre l'heure de stationnement et délivre un ticket. Chaque horodateur dispose d’un numéro d’identification. Avec ce numéro, il est possible aussi d’obtenir un ticket virtuel par sms ou par app mobile. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are parking meter, parkingmeter, car park meter, parking, mobility, parking. The portal shows 1,278 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
